warnings: This is a general program-information page for the City of Waltham Recreation Department, not a page for one specific camp. It names no summer camp programs.
The only brochures posted are for Fall 2026. No 2027 summer program details (sessions, dates, prices, ages) are posted yet.
The Spring/Summer 2027 registration date (March 16, 2027, 12:00 noon) covers the whole season. It is not tied to any particular camp session, so no sessions were recorded.
